correctness.rationale: The full Hilbert basis is proved by Euclidean division in the cone; determinants of every possible independent triple are evaluated exactly. For all dual weights, comparing third-coordinate sign reduces the lower envelope to four explicit monomials. Four strictly exposing weights prove those are the exact Newton vertices. The facet normal moves from (n-1,n-1,-1) to (n,n,-1) for \(p\mid n\), and the first ceases to be a ray, proving the fans differ. The accompanying integer verifier independently enumerated exact monomial exponents for \(3\le n\le24\) and characteristics 0,2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23; its finite tests are auxiliary, not the proof.

value.rationale: This gives a sharp divisibility criterion for every \(n\ge3\) and every prime, proves for every prime a normal affine toric threefold whose normalized Nash fan depends on characteristic, and computes a precise primitive interior ray displacement. It extends the exceptional-char-two threefold phenomenon to every prime and clarifies the three-dimensional boundary of published characteristic-independence results for surfaces, not just a single isolated numerical example.
